name: Tim Bedford
title: CEO
bio: Tim Bedford is a mission-driven leader with over twenty years of experience in cross-cultural ministry. Originally from California and raised in Texas, Tim discovered his calling during a 2003 mission trip to Mexico, which sparked his passion for the Spanish language and serving the Mexican community. He holds a BA in International Studies from the University of North Texas and an MA in Cross-Cultural Ministry from Dallas Theological Seminary. Tim and his wife, Tonantzi, began their ministry journey in 2007 with SERVE International, a ministry of Denton Bible Church, in Monterrey, Mexico, and have since led initiatives in church planting, leadership development, and ministry growth throughout Latin America. In 2020, Tim joined Paraclete Mission Group and assumed the role of CEO in 2025, continuing his commitment to equipping leaders and advancing the Great Commission worldwide.

name: Tona Bedford
title: Administrative Specialist
bio: Tona (Tonantzi) and her husband, Tim, have been Associates with Paraclete Mission Group since 2020. She stepped into the staff role of Administrative Assistant to Paraclete’s CEO in 2023. The Bedfords worked as missionaries to Mexico since 2007. They served first in Monterrey, Mexico 2007-2008. In 2008, they relocated to Denton, Texas while raising support and receiving additional ministry training. Then in 2010 the moved their base to Queretaro, Mexico to conduct their national and international ministry of local church development, discipleship, worship, and church planting.</br>In addition to her administrative responsibilities, Tona works with worship teams, conducts interpretation for non-Spanish speakers, and home schools their three children. She enjoys writing songs, singing, and crafts

name: Caitlyn Kasper
title: Assistant to the CEO
bio: My name is Caitlyn and I am from Ohio. I am a proud product of the public schools and give constant gratitude for the opportunity I had in middle and high school to take Spanish classes. Since watching Dora as a girl, I had always wanted to become fluent in the language. </br> One of my teachers in high school really encouraged us to take risks and to apply the language outside of the classroom and shared her passion for the culture, which spurred my desire to study Spanish and Education at Wheaton College. </br> This then led me to many wonderful experiences, including a semester of studying abroad in Queretaro, Mexico, which is where I landed a few years after graduation to be with my husband, Pablo. Who would have thought a girl from Medina, Ohio would up in Queretaro, Mexico? It wasn’t in my original plan, but the Lord has gracefully guided my life to be here in Queretaro, where I have lived happily for the past three years.</br> Here in Queretaro, Pablo and I serve together in our local church, Iglesia Biblica Cristo Salva, as leaders of the Young Adult Ministry. After attending Wheaton and working for The Navigators summer camp ministry (shoutout to Eagle Lake!), I grew an affinity for faith-based work.</br>  Now, with experience of working in both public and private schools around the US and in Mexico, this fondness has led me to work with Paraclete as the Assistant to the CEO, Tim Bedford. </br> I am passionate about community and connection and am excited to grow within this new position!

name: Jonathan Delfosse
title: Operations Manager
bio: Jonathan Delfosse is the operations manager for Paraclete with a background in ministry, business, and leadership. He handles Paraclete’s daily operations, payroll, web posts, expense reports and various other tasks that keep Paraclete running. Jonathan has a vision to serve others. He hopes to assist the associates of Paraclete however he can. He serves at his local church in technical ministries and Bible study teacher. He’s based in St. Augustine, FL. </br> Jonathan’s ministry experience started in 2000 when he went to college to study to be a pastor. From there, he was a part of traveling drama and youth ministry teams that served the needs of churches in the southeastern part of the United States. Jonathan and his wife, Wendy, met in Bible college, got married and move to NC so Jonathan could finish his bachelor’s degree. In NC, he served at his local church as a youth leader and Sunday school teacher, and then as the media director for his church in south Florida. He’s currently a trustee at his current church in St. Augustine, Fla.

name: Kim Thompson
title: Personnel Team
bio: Kim Thompson is a member of the Paraclete Personnel Team.  As our Hiring Lead, Kim is usually the first person to interact with new candidates.  Others on the team typically get involved in one way of another, but Kim watches over the whole process from first contact to onboarding.  Because of the autonomy that we give to Paraclete associates after they are hired, our vetting process is considerable.  And because most candidates are experienced professionals, joining Paraclete is a significant transition.  Kim guides folks through that process.   Her responsibilities also include work in other HR functions like benefits and payroll.

name: John Millstead
title: IT and Risk Manager
bio: John Millstead has a passion for helping missionaries and church leaders to fulfill the Great Commission of Jesus Christ. He has a diverse background including military, corporate finance, missionary service, law enforcement and entrepreneurial start-ups. John oversees Paraclete’s Informational Technology and Risk Management. John and his wife, Anna are also missionary associates with Paraclete Mission Group.
